rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=1024, gs_n_iter=130, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.3, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-8 (search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB (regularization): gs_tv_weight 1e-4->1e-3 (10x the total-variation smoothness penalty on the rasterized mu). Base = iter-6 BEST (warm-start + SSIM-loss@0.30, 1024G/130it, gs_scale_init reverted 0.02->0.04 since iter-7 finer-scale was marginally WORSE). Budget-neutral free-parameter change. PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-4 0.8539/22.50 (warm), iter-5 0.9264/28.55 (SSIM@0.15), iter-6 0.9278/28.67 (SSIM@0.30, BEST), iter-7 0.9276/28.64 (finer scale 0.02, FLAT/worse -> basis-scale lever exhausted). hr pinned 0 at EVERY iter; best PSNR 28.67 vs 128-view FBP baseline 35.97 (7.3 dB gap). FAILURE MODE: coarse Gaussian basis plateaus at SSIM ~0.928 / PSNR ~28.7 dB across ALL levers mapped so far (steps FLAT, capacity +0.01, warm-start +0.039, SSIM-loss +0.073 then saturated, basis-scale FLAT). The recon may have residual splat-boundary artifacts that a stronger TV penalty could smooth toward the FBP RMSE. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): 10x TV regularization suppresses inter-Gaussian discontinuities, dropping RMSE below iter-6 0.01211 / lifting PSNR above 28.67 toward the FBP floor. FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.9278 / PSNR <= 28.67 (no lift, or over-smoothed), TV is not the missing lever -> the ~7 dB gap to the FBP floor is the fundamental coarse-basis ceiling, hr stays 0. val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT (gs_outer_wall_s=1080). BUDGET: TV weight is free; same ~660-1000s. TRAJECTORY: iter-6 0.9278 (BEST) -> iter-7 0.9276 (finer scale, flat) -> iter-8 10x-TV test., gs_outer_wall_s=1080, gs_amp_init_max=0.05
